name: smwmusic-blaster-master-zero-next-level-sampled-fm-arrange
title: Blaster Master Zero - Next Level (Sampled FM Arrange)
description:
The second theme that plays in the overhead parts of Blaster Master Zero, now with a FM twist! Well, except it's not really actual FM, but sampled FM instead; I mean come on, what would you expect from the SNES LMAO

Anyway, this theme is a very epic and final-sounding one, so it would definitely work well in castles and the like. It could also work for factory levels too!

Thanks to Dippy for providing a MIDI after I requested it to him btw! You have no idea how huge of a help it was for me to make this haha
